taxonomies.name: Color Characteristics
taxonomies.definition: Visual color properties and variety of the product, e.g. brightness, vibrancy, color selection

taxonomies.name: Product Form
taxonomies.definition: Overall physical shape and structural integrity of the item, e.g. straightness, deformation

taxonomies.name: Product Dimensions
taxonomies.definition: Physical size measurements and proportions of the product, e.g. container volume, item dimensions suitable for children

taxonomies.name: Handling Ergonomics
taxonomies.definition: Physical design features that affect how the product is held and manipulated, e.g. grip comfort, handling ease

taxonomies.name: Container Design
taxonomies.definition: Physical structure and condition of product packaging, e.g. box construction, lid mechanisms, packaging integrity

taxonomies.name: Writing Point Performance
taxonomies.definition: Physical condition and functionality of writing or drawing tips, e.g. tip durability, sharpness, smoothness

taxonomies.name: Material Composition
taxonomies.definition: Physical substance and quality of materials used in product construction, e.g. safety ingredients, material durability

taxonomies.name: Surface Feel
taxonomies.definition: Tactile properties of product surfaces, e.g. smoothness, texture quality
